scope: 默认分支、README 已提取目标及已有安装映射；不穷举历史版本、不安装或执行插件

plugin.name: dsh-os-kit
plugin.title: dsh-os-kit
plugin.description: Thin meta bundle that installs and mounts the six core dsh-os modules: Act, Allow, Snip, Check, Kernel and Shell.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-act
plugin.title: dsh-act
plugin.description: Typed action registry with filesystem actions, previews and undo for DeepSeek Harness.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-allow
plugin.title: dsh-allow
plugin.description: Revocable capability grants and an audit-ready permission center for DeepSeek Harness.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-snip
plugin.title: dsh-snip
plugin.description: Local-first, searchable clipboard ledger for DeepSeek Harness with explicit OS clipboard capture, secret exclusion and clipboard:// agent handles.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-nest
plugin.title: dsh-nest
plugin.description: Versioned workspace profiles for DeepSeek Harness: context, permissions, environment and defaults.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-trigger
plugin.title: dsh-trigger
plugin.description: Event-to-action trigger fabric for DeepSeek Harness: condition DSL, cooldown, run ledger and real agent / fs / webhook event sources.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-seek
plugin.title: dsh-seek
plugin.description: Cross-source evidence search for DeepSeek Harness with verifiable refs, resolvable/tainted markers, resolve routing and real locator/memento/trace providers.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-stage
plugin.title: dsh-stage
plugin.description: Display, window and space topology protocol for DeepSeek Harness agents, with native macOS/Windows adapters and reversible layouts.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-ring
plugin.title: dsh-ring
plugin.description: Approval SLA and escalation receipts for DeepSeek Harness: ack, escalate, audit and opt-in webhook/ntfy delivery.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-canary
plugin.title: dsh-canary
plugin.description: Paired-environment regression canary for DeepSeek Harness upgrades, model changes and plugin updates.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-runtime-env
plugin.title: dsh-runtime-env
plugin.description: Named, explainable and snapshot-able environment profiles for DeepSeek Harness.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-record
plugin.title: dsh-record
plugin.description: Auditable long-term memory governance for DeepSeek Harness: provenance, expiry, conflict, forget, optional dsh:// ref verification, and a read-only dsh-memento bridge.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-os-kernel
plugin.title: dsh-os-kernel
plugin.description: Thin capability kernel for dsh-os: descriptor protocol, registry, legacy tool bridge, six os_* verbs, Allow grant bridge, content-hash taint gate and optional idempotency journal.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-help
plugin.title: dsh-help
plugin.description: Read-only install doctor and first-run wizard for the dsh-os module family.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-scene
plugin.title: dsh-scene
plugin.description: Read-only context provider protocol for DeepSeek Harness: app, window, selection, clipboard metadata and files, with isolated provider snapshots.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-price
plugin.title: dsh-price
plugin.description: Optional cost adapter for dsh-cost-meter: meter passthrough plus a local USD budget ledger and pre-flight gate for DeepSeek Harness.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-timecapsule
plugin.title: dsh-timecapsule
plugin.description: Read-only, allowlisted filesystem snapshot manifests and restore plans for DeepSeek Harness: metadata inventory with sensitive-path exclusions and hard caps, no copying and no deleting.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-buzz
plugin.title: dsh-buzz
plugin.description: Channel registry, routing and delivery ledger for DeepSeek Harness notifications.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors

plugin.name: dsh-os-shell
plugin.title: dsh-os-shell
plugin.description: Optional UI shell for dsh-os: a view contribution registry, an owner-only JSON bridge and a minimal React client for approvals, activity, Act, Snip and Check.
plugin.author: PerryLink contributors
